title.en: Signed field section with a stable legend

summary: Expose an interior scalar field without losing the meaning of sign, missing values or the section position.
objective: Expose an interior scalar field without losing the meaning of sign, missing values or the section position.
example_prompts: Use signed field section with a stable legend for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Choose a section, surface or volume view according to the question; a denser image is not automatically more informative.
Keep selection emphasis separate from the color channel carrying values.
implementation: Retain source coordinates and sampled values; apply a presentation transform only to the view.
Show the section position and a value probe; preserve or explicitly disclose legend-range changes during playback.
Offer a fixed-camera comparison and a reset to the initial section.
observable_checks: Probe the same coordinate before and after camera motion: the value and units agree.
Missing samples have a distinct state rather than silently becoming zero.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
